dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Interlocking networks of irregular 'O' and 'U' shaped rings with sharp, high-intensity light-gray perimeters. The geometry features jagged, non-linear edges with abrupt step-function transitions from light borders to dark-gray internal pixel values.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid clusters; most high-intensity features are annular. Scattered small, solid light-gray punctate pixels are visible along the lower lateral boundary and the anterior neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A central group of four large macro-annuli forms an irregular quadrilateral configuration in the mid-dorsal region; three smaller adjacent rings on the posterior-dorsal flank form a distinct scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp longitudinal transition zone where the complex annular texture topology terminates into a solid, low-intensity dark region on the ventral-posterior flank.
